title: Open restrictions and assembly of the finite projection diamond
statement: For a finite commutative coefficient ring A, a cartesian scheme square, a compactification c of its vertical map and arbitrary fixed-scalar inputs K,L, assume equality of the two proper-factor routes. Then the actual compactification diamond words agree, and restriction of each open-factor route followed by the target open-unit inverse equals the independently constructed openSource. The assumption is only equality of the proper-factor routes, and none of the three conclusions is that assumption. Use the maps of [def-sf-finite-projection-exchange-coordinates].

proof.text: Use open_factor_routes for the two open restrictions and for equality of the original open routes. This is a completely proved calculation of the canonical maps, not an additional normalization assumption.

Prove the three inverse rearrangements of leftDerivedUpperStarComp_assoc_app, allowing equality-transport on the composite map. Express theta as the inverse comparison through the diagonal followed by the other comparison. Apply these three rearrangements and cancel inverse pairs to prove compactification_square, identifying the remaining compactification target maps. All these calculations are proved from the published pro-etale associativity theorem.

Expand the compactification projection and exchange into proper and open factors. Rewrite naturality of exchange twice, and the supplied proper-factor equality after cancelling its invertible tensor comparisons. Move beta past the proper projection by naturality. The equality of the open routes, naturality in the second tensor argument, and compactification_square identify the remaining maps inside the proper direct image. This proves the compactification diamond. Pair it with the two already established restriction equations.
